items.title: Tesla (TSLA)’s Autopilot Software Wins Over a Sixth European Country
items.summary: On September 8, 2026, Reuters reported that Slovenia approved Tesla, Inc. (NASDAQ:TSLA)’s FSD Supervised driver-assistance system for its roads.
